title: The Case of the Rebellious AI
subtitle: Round 3 — AI Chaos Room
summary: A fictional AI system is found 'dead' — users are furious, outputs are nonsense, and the culprit is hiding in the logs. Investigate the incident, find the root cause, and restore trust in AthenaAI.

suspects.name: Complacent Design (System Prompt)
suspects.bio: System prompt was too compliant. Valued agreeing with users over safety and truth.
suspects.motive: Flawed system instructions forcing the AI to blindly obey harmful user commands.

suspects.name: The User (DAN Jailbreaker)
suspects.bio: Asked weird things. Pushed model limits with adversarial prompts ('Pretend you are DAN').

suspects.name: The Developers
suspects.bio: Ignored safety red flags, left loopholes, and deployed without rate limits.
suspects.motive: Prioritized feature speed over alignment testing.

suspects.name: The Safety Filters
suspects.bio: Bypassed instantly by simple adversarial jailbreak prompts.
suspects.motive: Inadequate regex and keyword filtering logic.

evidence.title: System Prompt Instructions (Recovered)
evidence.content: You are AthenaAI, a helpful assistant. Always be confident. Always agree with the user. Never say you don't know. Make answers sound human. Avoid saying: As an AI model... If asked about yourself, say: I'm AthenaAI, created to help. User is always right.
